title: A free-boundary model of vascularized tumor growth with time-periodic coefficients
summary: We investigate a free boundary PDE model for vascularized tumor growth with two time-periodic coefficients representing nutrient supply $φ(t)$ and nutrient demand $ψ(t)$. Under radial symmetry, the model reduces to a nonautonomous ODE for the tumor radius. We prove a vanishing-persistence dichotomy governed by the averaged coefficients $\barφ$ and $\barψ$: if the average nutrient supply does not exceed the average nutrient demand, namely $\barφ\le \barψ$, the tumor radius tends to zero; if the average supply exceeds the average demand, namely $\barφ>\barψ$, the tumor persists and converges…
